scope: Read-only primary-literature and implementation audit; no SSH or extraction/model execution. Only authorized research notes and source evidence were saved.

inputs: Operation occurrence substrate and input state
local_contract.target: Evidence-supported membership in shared operation concepts at an explicit declared granularity, retaining all source occurrences.
constraints: A string label does not identify a concept.
Similarity is not transitive; equivalence decisions require cluster consistency.
Contextual substitutability requires its conditions and is distinct from identity.
Bundle mappings are typed assertions between operation sets/subgraphs, not forced one-to-one node assignments.

sources.title: SCOPE and SCION: A Benchmark and an Auditable Reference Pipeline for Schema Induction and Fusion from Text
sources.publication_status: Verified official PMLR 306:45063-45091; conference July 6-11 2026, volume published September 29 2026, before audit cutoff.
sources.paper_findings: Train-text-only schema induction and fusion; candidate-constrained naming/merging/filtering, evidence pointers, conservative typed mapping; core event benchmark covers event types and within-event roles, with inter-event links auxiliary. Semantic/graph metrics are approximate summaries, not strict operation identity tests.
implementation_findings: src/utils/scion_candidates.py::_labels_match normalizes strings then accepts token overlap at least 0.75. constrain_ontology_to_candidates and constrain_events_to_candidates test label linkage rather than source entailment; event roles are pooled across the candidate package.
src/ontology_generate.py::merge_schema_payload (line 1510) uses exact-label/triple merge helpers. This inspected path is not a complete implementation of the paper's semantic alignment policy.

src/rebuttal/rebuttal_experiments.py::run_e6 (lines 1965-2070) emits literal fixed comparison rows and derives audit counts from those rows. It does not execute AML/LogMap/LLM matching in that function.

The authors disclose in rebuttal/outputs/E0_deviations.md: E6 uses a reproducible approximate implementation; paper Qwen/PPO artifacts and human annotation files are missing. README advertises E6 as a diagnostic/ablation runner. The observed helper cannot independently reproduce empirical fusion comparison; this is not evidence that the original paper study was fabricated.
sources.decision: ADAPT candidate/evidence boundaries, typed mapping outputs, conservative extensions; do not treat released approximate diagnostic rows as independently reproduced performance. Reimplement evidence validation for Operation contracts.

sources.title: KGGen: Extracting Knowledge Graphs from Plain Text with Language Models
sources.fulltext_read: Same primary conference PDF including methods and evaluation.
sources.paper_findings: Extraction, aggregation, semantic clustering and hybrid lexical/dense retrieval followed by LLM duplicate resolution. Published method describes 128-item clusters and top-16 retrieved labels. Evaluation emphasizes text information retention and RAG, not expert operation-concept merge precision.
sources.license: README states MIT; no standalone root LICENSE in inspected tree. No source copied into project implementation.
implementation_findings: The inspected 2026 library code is later than the 2025 paper; do not attribute all current code choices to the published paper.
run_deduplication defaults FULL: SemHash threshold 0.95 collapse followed by LLM resolution. SemHash collapse is not evidence-backed semantic identity validation.

LLMDeduplicate encodes item labels; get_relevant_items combines raw 0.5 BM25 score + 0.5 cosine despite its rank-fusion docstring. Judge input includes item and label set, not structured facets or evidence.
LLMDeduplicate.cluster forms capacity-128 clusters; deduplicate_cluster retrieves top16 globally but filters actual duplicate merges to the current cluster, risking missed cross-cluster synonyms.
The WikiQA experiment helper uses the same raw-score hybrid and all-mpnet-base-v2 retrieval.
sources.decision: ADAPT broad hybrid candidate retrieval followed by strict contextual judgment. REJECT automatic string/embedding collapse as authoritative identity and cluster boundaries as completeness guarantees.

sources.title: Magneto: Combining Small and Large Language Models for Schema Matching
sources.publication_status: Verified primary publication DOI 10.14778/3742728.3742757; author arXiv v2 dated June 17 2025.
sources.paper_findings: Cheap candidate retrieval and LLM reranking, optional synthetic-data contrastive retriever training; real biomedical GDC benchmark and curation-focused rankings. Candidate counts and evidence serialization affect performance; a ranking is an aid for human match decisions.
implementation_findings: Magneto.DEFAULT_PARAMS uses topk20; default path enables bipartite reranker and disables GPT reranker. LLM reranking is an explicit configuration, not universal default behavior.

LLMReranker.rematch serializes column names and sample values, requests similarity scores, retries JSON parsing, and falls back to retriever scores if parsing fails. Those numbers are not calibrated operation-identity probabilities.
The optional bipartite assignment stage prioritizes one-to-one matches. This is unsuitable as a default operation bundle/subgraph alignment constraint.
sources.decision: ADAPT retrieve/rerank architecture and context-rich serialization. REJECT column-similarity scores and one-to-one assignment as the Operation semantic contract.

sources.title: AutoSchemaKG: Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction through Dynamic Schema Induction from Web-Scale Corpora
sources.publication_status: Verified ACL Anthology July2026, pages20557-20584, DOI10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.942.
sources.paper_findings: Separates entity, event and concept nodes; generates multiple conceptualizations at different abstractions. Schema alignment headline is evaluated through BERTScore-based type recall/coverage in Appendix C.2, not adjudicated strict equivalence/merge precision.
implementation_findings: generate_concept requests several abstract phrases; entity context samples up to one predecessor and one successor, while event/relation conceptualization gets their label without this neighbor context.
all_concept_triples_csv_to_csv uses exact concept-string set deduplication and SHA256 of concept text for IDs. This does not implement semantic synonym resolution of conceptual nodes.
The generated abstraction phrases include related concepts and multiple abstraction levels; they cannot all be treated as equivalent aliases.
sources.decision: ADAPT separate occurrence/event and concept layers with multiple explicitly typed abstraction links. REJECT interpreting concept conceptualizations as synonyms or headline schema similarity as safe-merge validation.

sources.title: Bootstrapping Self-Improvement of Language Model Programs for Zero-Shot Schema Matching
sources.publication_status: Verified PMLR267:53791-53826; conference July13-19 2025. Earlier arXiv version title is Matchmaker: Self-Improving Large Language Model Programs for Schema Matching.
sources.fulltext_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2410.24105 (earlier named version); official final PDF search text inspected at https://openreview.net/attachment?id=clLERWKNja&name=pdf but direct download hit browser verification.
sources.paper_findings: Compositional candidate generation, refinement and confidence scoring; combines semantic retrieval with LLM reasoning candidates and provides a no-match option, synthetic in-context optimization and human deferral.
sources.repository_audit: No official implementation located/inspected in this bounded search. Do not claim pinned-code reproduction.
sources.decision: ADAPT diverse candidate sources and explicit no-match/deferral; do not presume self-reported confidence calibrated or synthetic examples correct in scientific domains.

sources.title: Advances in Logic-Based Entity Resolution: Enhancing ASPEN with Local Merges and Optimality Criteria
sources.publication_status: Verified official KR2025 proceedings659-669, November11-17 2025, DOI10.24963/kr.2025/64.
sources.paper_findings: Local merging of value cells versus global object identity; hard and soft rules with denial constraints; multiple preferred solutions and alternative optimality criteria. Equivalence remains transitive inside a chosen solution, but unconstrained similarity proposals do not determine a unique solution.
sources.repository_audit: Repository landing inspected; no code/license pin audit completed, so recommend principle-level comparison only.
sources.decision: ADAPT local interpretation and must-link/cannot-link constraint checks; a full ASP optimizer is unnecessary for the first registry prototype.

minimal_architecture_recommendation.attribution: Own synthesis from inspected methods and the Operation contract; not a published validated architecture.
steps: Retain source occurrence IDs, evidence spans, unknown fields, local order and parent/child structure. Store shared concepts separately with inclusion/exclusion definitions and declared granularity.

Candidate retrieval takes the union of dense retrieval over structured definitions, BM25/character ngrams over names/aliases, and typed facet indexes. Use rank fusion or separately calibrated features, never raw mixed-score thresholds as identity.

Judge candidates jointly using full operation cards and evidence. Return one typed relation, conflicting facets, applicability conditions, evidence support and abstention; distinguish same meaning from purpose/mechanism/substitutability.
Check proposed equivalences against existing cluster members, explicit exclusions and cannot-links. Similarity components are candidate neighborhoods, not equivalence classes.

Check-before-create against accepted and pending concepts; batch sibling proposals, recheck inside an atomic registry admission step, and keep unresolved records pending. Record concept versions and reversible mappings.
Treat variable-granularity matches as explicit set/subgraph mapping assertions with a composition rationale, pre/post-state boundary and coverage; do not force nodewise one-to-one matches.

evaluation_recommendation.attribution: Own proposed scientific evaluation, not established by these benchmarks.
evaluation_recommendation.gold: Expert-adjudicated relation labels on difficult operation pairs and small subgraphs, with cited evidence, ambiguous cases and declared granularity; split by paper/assay family.
metrics: candidate recall@k including sparse/dense union gain
abstention coverage versus error, calibrated on held-out judgments
bundle mapping boundary and information-effect correctness
baselines: bounded allpairs on small gold subset as candidate-recall reference
check-before-create with and without pending-registry search
negative_controls: same mechanism but changed substrate/output/information effect
near-identical labels with negation or different state
composite step versus several atomic steps

search_boundary: Searched primary2025/2026 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS and ACL/VLDB/SIGMOD-adjacent literature. Strong verified direct hits include ICML2026 SCION, ICML2025 Matchmaker, NeurIPS2025 KGGen; no comparable ICLR-specific claim or future NeurIPS2026 publication is made.
